title: We use limits to describe how a function behaves as its input approaches a certain value.
Sum Rule
equation: \[ \lim_{{x \to a}} [f(x) + g(x)] = \lim_{{x \to a}} f(x) + \lim_{{x \to a}} g(x) \]

title: Product Rule
equation: \[ \lim_{{x \to a}} [f(x) \cdot g(x)] = \lim_{{x \to a}} f(x) \cdot \lim_{{x \to a}} g(x) \]

title: Quotient Rule
equation: \[ \lim_{{x \to a}} \frac{f(x)}{g(x)} = \frac{\lim_{{x \to a}} f(x)}{\lim_{{x \to a}} g(x)}, \text{ if } \lim_{{x \to a}} g(x) \neq 0 \]
